_comment: Single source of truth for the Event Sync SHIPPED parse patterns (bead ti939.1.5; blocker fix PR #614 review). Consumed by BOTH frontend/src/components/channelPipeline/eventSyncDefaults.ts (via resolveJsonModule) and backend/tests/services/test_event_sync_shipped_frontend_patterns.py, which runs every entry's example through the real parse_event_name with now=pinned_now and asserts expected_title/expected_start — so a shipped pattern that cannot parse its own example can never ship again, and the builtin entries are pinned verbatim against DEFAULT_EVENT_PATTERNS in backend/services/event_sync_matcher.py.

patterns.label: Title @ Day-first date (built-in)
patterns.description: Optional "Slot NN :" prefix, then title, then "@ <day> <month> <time>". Matches the most common live shape.
patterns.example: Fubo Sports Network 07 : Yankees vs Red Sox @ 11 Jul 06:00 PM ET

patterns.label: Title @ Month-first date (built-in)
patterns.description: Optional "Slot NN :" prefix, then title, then "@ <month> <day> [year] <time>".
patterns.example: Peacock 14: Lyon vs Marseille @ Jan 17 02:45 PM ET

patterns.label: Title Day-first date (no "@")
patterns.description: For providers that drop the "@" separator: title followed directly by "<day> <month> <time>".
patterns.example: Yankees vs Red Sox 11 Jul 06:00 PM ET

patterns.label: Title Month-first date (no "@")
patterns.description: For providers that drop the "@" separator: title followed directly by "<month> <day> [year] <time>".
patterns.example: Lyon vs Marseille Jan 17 02:45 PM ET
